verdict.rationale: Gusto documents a 401(k) offering via its Guideline partnership, with pre-built flows for employer admins to set up access, and lists 401(k) as one of its integrated benefit offerings alongside payroll [gusto-docs-36, gusto-docs-39, gusto-docs-42]. However, the evidence does not explicitly describe the automatic contribution-sync mechanism with each payroll run, nor employee enrollment/deduction details, and there is no independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific behavior. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic per-payroll contribution syncing, employee-side setup flow, and third-party/hands-on validation.
